_comment: Browser extension IDs allowed to start the native host com.eid.download. Read by scripts/windows/native_host_manifests.py when the Windows installer is built (crates/eid-gui/installer/README.md). PLACEHOLDER VALUES: the extension IDs are not final yet. Set the real IDs and "placeholder": false before a release; a tag build refuses placeholder IDs. An empty list means that browser is not registered by the installer.
